achievements.name: Hotel Z
achievements.detail: Join Team MZ and make Hotel Z your base in Lumiose City.

achievements.name: Wild Catch
achievements.detail: Catch a Pokémon living in one of Lumiose City's wild zones.

achievements.name: Real-Time Win
achievements.detail: Win a battle by moving with your Pokémon and calling moves in real time.

achievements.name: Battle Zone
achievements.detail: After dark, enter a battle zone and defeat another trainer.

achievements.name: Bonus Card
achievements.detail: Complete the task on a bonus card during a night in a battle zone.

achievements.name: Rank Climbed
achievements.detail: Earn a Challenger's Ticket and win a promotion match in the Z-A Royale.

achievements.name: Mega Evolve
achievements.detail: Mega Evolve a Pokémon in battle while it holds a Mega Stone.

achievements.name: Rogue Calmed
achievements.detail: Calm a Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon rampaging in Lumiose City.

achievements.name: Mega Shards
achievements.detail: Break Mega Crystals around the city and collect the Mega Shards.

achievements.name: Town Favor
achievements.detail: Complete a side quest for someone in Lumiose City.

achievements.name: Club Win
achievements.detail: Win a Link Battle in the Z-A Battle Club.

achievements.name: Rank A
achievements.detail: Win through the Z-A Royale until you reach Rank A.
